verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability and improvement platform for AI agents. A buyer could reasonably ask whether it supports scheduled recurring evaluations or workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only event-driven features: real-time signal firing, backfills, alert routing, and CI-based release scoring. Running the CLI from a user's own script or CI is a user-side workaround, not a product scheduling capability, so none of this documents user-defined recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
